choices.content: The foot of the perpendicular from \(A\) to \(BC\)
The intersection of the bisector of \(\angle A\) with \(BC\)

question.prompt: A uniform triangular thin plate \(ABC\) is suspended from vertex \(A\). When it comes to rest, the suspension line (a vertical line) passes through the plate's center of gravity. Its intersection with side \(BC\) is:

solutions.explanation: The center of gravity lies on the median \(AD\) to side \(BC\). The suspension line passes through \(A\) and the center of gravity, so its intersection with \(BC\) is the midpoint of \(BC\).
solutions.title: Center of gravity on a median
